## Starting point

The project currently contains only a `package.json` depending on `next@latest`
(Next.js 16.0.0 installed) and an empty `app/` directory. There is no `src/`,

- **Content model lives in Prismic, code lives in the repo.** Page types and

- **Full-site previews via Draft Mode.** `/api/preview` and `/api/exit-preview`

   export const repositoryName = config.repositoryName;

   import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
   import { SliceZone } from "@prismicio/react";
   import { createClient } from "@/prismicio";
   import { components } from "@/slices";

   type Params = { uid: string };

   export default async function Page({ params }: { params: Promise<Params> }) {
     const { uid } = await params;
     const client = createClient();
     const page = await client.getByUID("page", uid).catch(() => notFound());
     return <SliceZone slices={page.data.slices} components={components} />;
   }

   export async function generateMetadata({ params }: { params: Promise<Params> }) {
     const { uid } = await params;
     const page = await createClient().getByUID("page", uid).catch(() => notFound());
     return {
       title: page.data.meta_title ?? page.data.title,
       description: page.data.meta_description,
       openGraph: { images: [page.data.meta_image?.url ?? ""] },
